insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.display: Option 1: 2% of SI/day; Option 2: Single Private Room
room_rent.note: Two options available as per Policy Schedule. Pro-rata clause applies if room exceeds eligibility.

icu.display: Option 1: Double of room rent/day; Option 2: Actuals
icu.note: Option 2 (actuals) available as per Policy Schedule selection.

copayment.note: Co-payment is mentioned as applicable if specified in Policy Schedule; no standard mandatory co-pay stated in wording.

sub_limits.display: Modern treatment sub-limits (e.g. Robotic ₹2.5L, Deep Brain Stim ₹5L)
sub_limits.note: Sub-limits on specific modern treatments: Deep Brain Stimulation ₹5L, Immunotherapy ₹5L, Intra vitreal injections ₹5L, Robotic surgeries ₹2.5L, Stereotactic radio surgeries ₹3.5L, Bronchial Thermoplasty ₹2L, Vaporisation of prostate ₹2L. Ambulance capped at ₹3,000.

deductible.note: Deductible is mentioned as applicable if specified in Policy Schedule; no standard deductible stated.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents covered from day 1.

ped_waiting.note: Option 1 is 36 months; Option 2 is 24 months as per Policy Schedule selection.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease/procedure waiting period as stated in Annexure I (24 months). Includes cataract, hernia, osteoarthritis, kidney disease, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a permanent standard exclusion (Code-Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus terms found in the policy wording.

restoration.display: Once/year, 100% of Base SI (unrelated illness only)
restoration.note: Re-fill Benefit reinstates 100% of Base Sum Insured once per policy year. Cannot be used for the same illness/complication for which a claim was already paid. Cannot be carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Two options as per Policy Schedule selection.

post_hosp.note: Two options as per Policy Schedule selection.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures covered up to SI
day_care.note: Covered up to Base Sum Insured for listed procedures as per Annexure V (536 listed procedures).

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalization is defined in the policy but not listed as a covered benefit in the product benefit table or scope of cover.

ayush.display: Covered up to Base SI (inpatient only)
ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered under Section 3.1.1.5. Yoga excluded. NABH/NQAS accreditation required for AYUSH hospital.

organ_donor.note: Covers living donor's inpatient treatment for organ harvesting. Donor's hospital stay, pre/post-hosp, screening, and organ transport costs excluded.

ambulance.note: ₹3,000 for both network and non-network hospitals. One transfer per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments covered; several have sub-limits. Uterine Artery Embolization, Balloon Sinuplasty, Oral Chemotherapy, Stem cell therapy covered up to SI.

consumables.note: Consumables such as gloves, masks, etc. are explicitly listed as non-payable in Annexure II. No consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states all benefits are available in India only (Section 4.22). Expenses outside India excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/non-monthly modes; 15 days for monthly premium payment mode.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only, not on renewals.

portability.note: IRDAI-mandated portability with transfer of PED waiting period credits, specific waiting periods, and moratorium credits.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, hormone replacement therapy, STIs (non-HIV), sleep disorders, dental (non-accident), external congenital anomaly, circumcision (non-medical), overseas treatment

optional_riders.display: Critical Illness Multiplier (3x SI for listed CIs, 3 options: 13/21/37 illnesses); PED waiting period reduction (36mo or 24mo); pre/post-hosp days options
